title: diag.1: lichen_diag core module — ring buffer, CoAP /diag, UART output
description: Create lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/lichen_diag.c. Ring buffer of diagnostic events (struct: timestamp, subsystem enum, event code, u32 detail, 32-byte message). lichen_diag_report() API callable from any subsystem. CoAP GET /diag returns CBOR array of recent events. UART prints human-readable on each event. Kconfig CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG, default y. ~150 lines.
